name: The Mountain God Rises (iQPS Launch 10)
agency: Institute for Q-shu Pioneers of Space
location_str: Rocket Lab LC-1A @ Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1, NZL
destination_explanation: Being close to the ground is the point: signals arrive quickly and cameras see fine detail, which is why internet and imaging satellites settle here.
slot_a_text: Synthetic aperture radar Earth observation satellite for Japanese Earth imaging company iQPS.
slot_b_text: Rocket Lab's 21st launch of the year, 100th all time. Their year has run at a launch every couple of weeks. No Electron has failed in 58 flights.
